 (Shri Ram Ratan And Others Vs The State Of Madhya Prade
 Dated : 21-07-2023
 Shri Jayant Prakash Patel - Advocate for the petitioners

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Siddharth Singh - Advocate for respondent no. 4.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that private respondent no. 4 in the same locality had entered into the agreements to acquire land and had paid compensation @ Rs. 11,00,000/- per acre whereas in the present case, petitioners are being given less than half of the amount on which land has been acquired by the private respondent.

It is submitted that the basic issue is that whether land could have been acquired invoking powers under Section 247 without resorting to the provisions contained in the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is also submitted that private respondent has when entered into the agreements and petitioners are also willing to enter into the agreement with the private respondent, then without taking his concurrence and depriving him of entering into such agreement with private respondent no. 4 with the said agreement with respondent no 4, can orders be passed by the S.D.O. ?
Let Collector, District Panna file his personal affidavit in this behalf.
In the meanwhile, respondent no. 4 shall also file his affidavit whether he is willing to acquire the land through agreement as has been done with the similarly placed farmers.
Shri Siddharth Singh submits that he be granted time to file detailed reply.

The land is not being acquired, only surface rights are being acquired but he is in agreement that once, surface rights are acquired for digging up the minerals, then that land will not be usable by the farmers and ownership rights will stay with them.
Two weeks' time is granted to do the needful.
